clippings.speaker: Matt Damon
clippings.quote: In Hollywood, by any measure, I was cold – cold as ice. And Steven was coming off his Oscar for Traffic and two of his movies were Best Picture nominees in the same year. By Hollywood standards, he was as hot as you could get. … And it was in that climate that he called me.
clippings.title: Exclusive Matt Damon Interview
clippings.context: Damon recalls Soderbergh offering him The Informant! in 2001, while he was stuck in Paris on Bourne reshoots and his career had stalled.

clippings.speaker: Matt Damon
clippings.quote: Formally, nobody has pushed the envelope more than Steven. He's done every kind of movie. He's totally fascinated by form. He's basically tried everything. And he's always in production.
clippings.title: Exclusive Matt Damon Interview
clippings.context: Asked what he admires about Soderbergh, in the same interview for The Informant!

clippings.speaker: Matt Damon
clippings.quote: I choose movies entirely based on who's directing them now. I have done movies with no script and they have turned out the way I wanted them to, just because of who the director was, so to have a director like Steven, and then on top of it, to have a script that was as good as any script I had read…
clippings.title: Behind the Candelabra - Interview with Matt Damon
clippings.context: Damon, at Cannes 2013, on why he didn't hesitate over playing Scott Thorson for Soderbergh.

clippings.speaker: Steven Soderbergh
clippings.quote: Well, that's Matt wanting to expand his experience as an actor and you got to give him credit for that. … You want somebody who's kind of fearless and we look at the complete transformation that Matt goes through in this. You're seeing somebody who sort of jumps off the cliff and doesn't look back, and that's what you want.
clippings.title: TIFF Interview: The Informant Director Steven Soderbergh
clippings.context: Soderbergh at the 2009 Toronto Film Festival, asked about pushing Damon as an actor in The Informant!

clippings.speaker: Steven Soderbergh
clippings.quote: Possibly, but I think Michael's point was that, at that stage in his life, in his career, he was I think more protective of his image as an actor than Matt is right now.
clippings.title: Interview: BEHIND THE CANDELABRA director Steven Soderbergh on the Liberace bio-pic
clippings.context: Soderbergh relays Michael Douglas's admiration for Damon's willingness to play Scott Thorson, comparing Damon to Douglas at the same age.

clippings.speaker: Steven Soderbergh
clippings.quote: Don't say anything around Matt when he's drunk that you don't want repeating because he does remember everything. He sort of embellished that story a little bit but I was shocked he remembered any of it, because at the time we were having this conversation he was not on this planet.
clippings.title: Soderbergh's Six: the Ocean's director on not panicking, not retiring and not trusting drunk Matt Damon
clippings.context: At Karlovy Vary 2024, Soderbergh on Damon being the one who first let slip, in 2013, that he was thinking of retiring.
